text:
toni: Heads-up: planning a multirack maintenance for eu-central + eu-north (nvlink driver + kernel livepatch). Window: Wed 2025-06-18 01:30-04:00 UTC. Rolling across 5 racks, cohorts of 4 nodes. Expect short evictions and transient tail latency.
akash: ETA on expected capacity loss? last similar run hit a temporary 15% shortfall.
toni: Target: drain non-dedicated pools first, keep reserved tenants pinned off impacted racks. We will maintain a hot reserve of 12 nodes per region and enable short preemptible burst for 40m.
elaine: Routing ask: add a temporary smart-routing fallback to route-eu->us-west if queue latency >140ms for EMEA origins. We should also log fallback events for postmortem.
sre-oncall: I'll run smoke and tail-checks after each cohort. Abort if p95 > 225ms for >5m or if node rejoin failures >1 per cohort.
toni: Runbook excerpt:
```
prep:
  increase-reserve --region eu-central --nodes 12
  enable-burst --duration 40m --type preemptible
cohort-loop:
  cordon cohort --grace 300
  drain cohort --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir
  reboot cohort
  kvseed --pool eu-shadow
  run smoke-tests --tags latency,queue
```
akash: Cost rough: 12 nodes * 2h + burst ~ $1.1k per region -> total ~ $2.2k. Finance signoff needed.
toni: @opsbot create FIN request and maintenance ticket. Also will post customer blurb tomorrow.
opsbot: Created MAINT-9902 and FIN-4410. Notified finance@redwood and posted to #customer-comm-draft.
elaine: Canary list: internal-loadgen + 2 low-traffic tenants + one reserved tenant moved to standby. I'll DM the list.
sre-oncall: I'll validate p50/p95 and queue depth after each cohort and post summaries here. If fallback triggers more than 3 times in a cohort we escalate and consider pausing.
toni: One more: increase KV cache TTL pre-window to reduce regen pressure. Post-window lower TTL back.
akash: Agreed. Also add a short T-30m dry-run: cordon a single node and validate route fallback log & kvseed job.
toni: Final readiness check at T-60. If green we start at 01:30 UTC. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
